name: AX-rover-11 RH-DC Articulated Hub Connector -- modern interior (light)
frame: Godot Y-up, metres; same origin as the exterior GLB; node +Y = direction, node +Z = up

crew_virtual.note: light part: no exterior seat; 1.8 m figure prone along the tunnel axis on the crawl mat (fit = radial bore clearance)

gravity.note: surface rover connector; gravity -Y Godot (CAD -Z): crew crawl prone on the rubber mat through the 0.99 m tunnel; no standing station

exterior_hide_note: none needed: the interior adds its own inner panes (window_glass stays)

crew_fit_iml.note: standing: feet / shins rest on the floor, excluded from the minimum

containment.note: signed distance of every tessellated vertex to the handoff IML mesh (inside > 0)

egress_paths.name: end_to_end_crawl
egress_paths.note: transit (crawl): widest axis-parallel clear cylinder along the tube, Godot z -0.500..+0.500, fixed items + IML side wall; moving door meshes excluded

exterior.note: exterior meshes with vertices inside the IML; hidden ones are listed in exterior_hide

reach.note: zero-g / floating: a handhold must be within arm reach of the station

contents: 0.99 m crawl-through connector (light): 2 rigid white trim rings on the flanges with black lips at the open ends, flexible corrugated off-white bellows liner (12 folds) across the articulation, 3-piece rubber crawl mat with graphite ribs (split at the articulation), 8 alu grab handles, 2 LED task lights, 4 yellow articulation caution labels
notes: frame: the connector's own origin is on the tunnel axis (node_front / node_rear y 0, node_bottom y -1.15): the iva 'axis at CAD z 1.15' is above node_bottom; it mates to the hub ring nodes (y -0.07) by node, no offset applied
no hatches / seats in iva or exterior nodes (light connector): egress = widest axial clear passage end to end (need 0.8 m)

the flexed pose (ax_rover_11_connector_flexed) pitches the rear flange 12 deg: the interior is split at the articulation (rigid trim rings on the flanges, flexible bellows liner + 3-piece crawl mat across it); the rear ring / mat piece would follow the flange (not animated here)

lod1.note: lod_b68 v2: blender collapse decimate (ratio R, seam meshes >= 0.30, meshes <= 16 tris kept, parts < 60 mm dropped, bbox guard); same node empties

source_note: site copy of parts/interiors_modern/ax/ax_rover_11/ax_rover_11_interior.nodes.json (build data dropped); glb_interior is the BAKED GLB (props embedded), so no prop instancing is needed; props_baked lists them
